A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (1 April 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata for this card; Decipher published no errata text for it.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-fx10effexten-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[FX-10 (Effex-ten)]] (Decipher, November 1996): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in the black lower border. The game text now reads: “Once per turn, one of your ‘hit’ non-droid characters at same or adjacent site may be placed in your Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when forfeited.”

The whole earlier card image and the whole of this card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
